title: Hermeus media slot
description: A square-cornered media slot: a real image or video fills it like object-fit: cover. Empty, it is plainly a placeholder in one of three looks: a flat grey surface (photos), a deeper grey (film), or a soft light pooled on the band itself (cut-out renders that sit on the page colour).
notes: size it from outside (aspect-*, h-full, absolute inset-0); it fills its box
the grey looks are mixed from the foreground, so they show on any band
name: hermeus-media

props.name: media
props.description: a real image or video; it is stretched to cover the slot. Empty: a plain placeholder

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will show, for screen readers (only used while it is empty)

props.name: look
props.description:
the empty look: "flat" a grey surface (photos), "deep" a darker grey (film),
"soft" a soft light on the band's own colour (cut-out renders)
